svg.title: OCR TRILOGY
svg.desc: OCR trilogy: one Tesseract OCR engine shipped three ways. 2020 FastAPI on Heroku; 2021 Flask-RESTX on Docker Hub; 2022 Flask web UI with Heroku and Azure continuous deployment.
svg.text: One OCR engine, three deployments. Same engine as
the Tesseract OCR apps I built at Humana.
